Model

04 · the model states its own measured error first

An income model, not three statements

a deliberate cut, with the reason

None of the twelve metrics we owe touches a balance-sheet or cash-flow line. There is no working capital, no debt, no cash and no interest expense anywhere in them. A linked balance sheet with a circular interest solve would have been real engineering that reaches nothing we are scored on, so what is built is the half that reaches all of it: history as filed, a ratio base of medians with the scaled MAD beside each, a projection, and the reproduction check. Two tests from the brief — the balance sheet tying to the cent, and no DCF assumption moving the forecast — are therefore not applicable, and are declared rather than quietly dropped.

Reproduction check

each recent period re-projected using only what was known before it — this leads the sheet because a model states its measured error before it is trusted with a projection
